window-1.title: ssh.place — Timelapses
window-1.blurb: Watch a whole day of strangers quietly fighting and collaborating over one 200×60 pixel canvas replay as a GIF — it's a tiny communal folk-art archive made entirely in a terminal, and I think you'll want to go claim a corner of it.

window-2.title: The radical reasons why you dream of making things by hand
window-2.blurb: This one makes the case that your hand-sewn costumes and ancestry archives aren't hobbies but a quiet rebellion — a whole essay arguing that the urge to master something with your hands is the most radical thing you can do.

window-3.title: Classic Vietnamese Plum Soda (Soda Xí Muội)
window-3.blurb: Salty-sour preserved plum drowned in fizz over cracked ice — it's the nostalgic, slightly feral cousin of every polite floral mocktail, and you get to eat the plum at the end like a prize.

window-4.title: Barcelona Remodel by Conti Cert: '70s Style Redux
window-4.blurb: You already know how to commit to a persona, so here's a whole apartment doing it — '70s Barcelona reworked with real warmth instead of costume-y nostalgia, and about five ideas in here you could steal for one corner of your place this weekend.

window-5.title: Slow Boat Vinyl Listening Café, Tanjong Pagar
window-5.blurb: A sibling-run listening café up a shophouse staircase where you pay by the hour and DJ your own afternoon — analogue, unhurried, and made for you and a disposable camera.
